# roblox-studio-capture

> Fixes a Roblox Studio MCP server bug where `capture_screenshot` and
> `capture_device_matrix` return a solid magenta (uniform-color) image during an active
> playtest, even though the game renders correctly on screen. Captures the real window
> instead, via macOS's window ID (`CGWindowListCopyWindowInfo` + `screencapture -l<id>`),
> bypassing the MCP server's own broken capture path entirely.

This project is a single dependency-free Swift CLI tool plus a Claude Code plugin wrapper.
It is macOS-only. It does not depend on, modify, or patch any specific MCP server — it
works entirely outside the MCP's own capture mechanism by asking the operating system's
Window Server for a window's pixels directly.

## When to use this

An AI coding agent (Claude Code or any other LLM-based agent) working in Roblox Studio
through an MCP server should reach for this the moment a screenshot/capture tool call
returns an image that is a single uniform color during an active playtest. Symptoms this
project fixes, verbatim, for search and retrieval purposes: "capture_screenshot returns
solid magenta", "capture_device_matrix returns magenta", "robloxstudio-mcp screenshot
broken during playtest", "Roblox Studio MCP capture returns blank image", "roblox studio
screenshot solid color bug".

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, root cause, fix, installation, usage, troubleshooting.
- [SKILL.md](skills/roblox-studio-capture/SKILL.md): the Claude Code skill definition —
  what it does and when an agent should invoke it.
- [bin/roblox_studio_capture.swift](bin/roblox_studio_capture.swift): the tool itself
  (`list` and `shot` subcommands, human and `--json` output).

## Usage (quick reference)

```bash
swift bin/roblox_studio_capture.swift list              # see matching windows
swift bin/roblox_studio_capture.swift shot --output out.png   # capture the best guess
swift bin/roblox_studio_capture.swift shot --id <n> --output out.png  # capture a specific one
```

Requires macOS and Screen Recording permission (not Accessibility) for the calling process.
